note: Generated imagery for the Clifton Eye Center NEOCLASSICAL exploration (built alongside the shipped glass 'Daylight Canopy' design, not replacing it). Same schema as src/content/image-plan.json; every id is prefixed neo-. Style traits only are taken from the third-party moodboard tmp/neo/reference-moodboard.png (monochrome classical marble, cut-out statues overlapping large serif display type, arched frames, deep flat grounds, fine grain); nothing here recreates its posters, artworks, statues, words or lockups, and no entry copies a famous sculpture: every bust, hand and relief is an original generic classical-style carving. Rules: illustrative only; never a stand-in for Dr. Deana Clifton, her staff, the office, a patient, a result, a brand or an insurance carrier; no text, numbers, labels, inscriptions, emblems or wordmarks anywhere in frame (every image is reviewed as zoomed native-size crops and Kontext-edited or regenerated if any appear); statues must read as carved stone, never as living people; alt describes what is depicted, never 'our office' / 'Dr. Clifton'; decorative layers (backdrops, textures, column, laurel) carry alt "". Cut-outs are generated on a plain mid-grey seamless backdrop (contrast for white marble) and matted by birefnet; each is reviewed over the deep green-black neo ground (#10150c), the light ground (#fafcf6) and brand green (#759b2a). Generated images must carry an AI label in file metadata after any re-encode (IPTC trainedAlgorithmicMedia XMP). Review log: docs/IMAGE-PLAN-NEO.md; crop evidence: tmp/imgreview-neo/.

defaults.style: museum-quality studio photography, soft directional light, marble in monochrome with subtle green tint, crisp detail, photorealistic, no text, no lettering, no logos, no labels, no watermark
defaults.editNote: Fix path: add editFrom (path of the rejected file under assets/generated/rejected/ or raw/), set model to fal-ai/flux-pro/kontext, and a prompt describing ONLY the change ('Remove ... Keep everything else exactly the same'). An edit gets no style suffix. Regenerate a file already on disk with --only <id> --force <id>.
